heading: Repealed. Pub. L. 94–265, title IV, § 402(a), Apr. 13, 1976, 90 Stat. 360

notes.text: Sections, Pub. L. 89–658, §§ 1–4, Oct. 14, 1966, 80 Stat. 908, set out provisions authorizing the establishment of a fishery zone contiguous to the territorial sea of the United States. See section 1801 et seq. of this title.

notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.text: Pub. L. 94–265, title IV, § 402(a), Apr. 13, 1976, 90 Stat. 360, provided that repeal of sections 1091 to 1094 of this title is effective Mar. 1, 1977.

ancestors.heading: FISHERIES ZONE CONTIGUOUS TO TERRITORIAL SEA OF THE UNITED STATES
